title: Duel Decks: Jace vs. Chandra: card flavor text

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker mind-mage who feigns interest while a pyromancer unleashes her mightiest fire.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who leaves places engulfed in flames and made fire her thing.

entities.name: Zur the Enchanter
entities.description: An enchanter who says the Balduvians' magic is potent and primal.

entities.name: Balduvians
entities.description: A people of the north whose magic is as potent as it is primal.

entities.name: Naimah
entities.description: A Femeref philosopher who warns that beauty to the eye does not always translate to the touch.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Captain of the Weatherlight, who asks to fly higher out of a storm and mocks flametongue kavu aim.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who asks what mana is but possibility.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who recalls the fireslinger fable that with power comes isolation.

entities.name: Gyara Spearhurler
entities.description: A spear thrower whose deadly accuracy would have made her renowned.

entities.name: Quicksilver Sea
entities.description: A sea of shimmering swirls over which a spire golem soars.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane whose surface slith emerge onto when the four suns align.

entities.name: Great Furnace
entities.description: A hot place on Mirrodin where slith incubate.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Smoldering crags patrolled by an Oxidda golem.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane made a casualty of the war of Urza and Mishra.

events.summary: A pyromancer summons her mightiest fire and rage, and Jace feigns interest.
After repeatedly leaving places engulfed in flames, Chandra decides to make fire her thing.
events.quote: After the fourth time Chandra left a place engulfed in flames, she decided to just go ahead and make it her thing.

events.summary: Karn recalls the fireslinger fable that power brings isolation.
events.quote: Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation.

events.summary: Sisay asks to fly higher out of a storm.
events.quote: Fly us higher, out of its storm.
